name: import_asset
title: import_asset
description: Copy an image or audio file from disk into res:// and queue it for Godot's import pipeline. Returns the res:// path to use in node properties (e.g. Sprite2D.texture).

source_path.description: Absolute path to the file on disk.

dest_path.description: Destination under res://. Defaults to res://assets/<filename>.

dry_run.description: Validate and report what would happen without copying.

errors.file_not_found: The source file does not exist.
errors.unsupported_format: Extension not in png, jpg, jpeg, webp, svg, wav, ogg, mp3.
errors.extension_mismatch: Destination extension must match the source file.
errors.already_exists: A file already exists at dest_path.
errors.copy_failed: Could not copy the file into the project.
errors.mkdir_failed: Could not create the destination directory.
